FIND YOUR WAY

Explore at your pace.

Orbit — drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan. Double-click a surface to focus.

Floor plan — see all three furnished pavilions with roofs and upper walls sectioned away. Double-click a floor to start walking there.

Walk through — drag to look or click for mouse capture. W A S D / arrows move, Shift moves faster, Q / E adjust height. Click a nearby door or press F to open or close it. Esc returns to orbit. Touch controls are available on phones.

Room views take you inside each pavilion. The guided tour visits every space; pause it at any time.

Movement checks walls at body and eye level. Q / E is a free height control; this is an architectural explorer rather than a stair or gravity simulation.
